name: EPIC 251585405
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 12.3 solar radii and 1.03 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 251585405 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.262074 (16th-84th percentiles 11.633095-12.941613), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 251585405: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4657.1514 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 251585405 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1638.671875 (16th-84th percentiles 1572.753906-1706.191406), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,639 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 1.03 solar masses and 12.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,657 K at its surface.
